_comment: Test files under tests/ that no CI step runs, each with a one-line reason. Checked by scripts/verify/check-test-coverage.mjs (CI step 'Check every test file is run once or excluded'); the same files are skipped by `npm test` so local and CI run the same set. Categories: needs browser, needs network, needs live auth, run after browser install, local sibling checkout, local fixture.

tests/analysis/live-auth-persistence-soa.reason: launches Playwright Chromium against a loopback server; excluded from the folder run, run by the step after the Chromium install in job verify

tests/ui/dom-settings-primitives.test.ts.reason: launches Playwright Chromium to measure real layout; excluded from the folder run, run by the step after the Chromium install in job verify

tests/playbook-adoption-evidence.test.mj.reason: compares the Mazer export with the live contract in the sibling ../playbook checkout (exports/playbook.contract.example.v1.json), which a CI checkout of this repo does not have

tests/playbook-verification-report.test..reason: validates the report against the ATLAS root schema (../../schemas/atlas.playbook.verification.report.v1.json), which is owned by the ATLAS repo and absent from a CI checkout of this repo

tests/reset/legacy-reset.test.ts.reason: read the local-only mazer-legacy-unreal-restore C++ source tree (21 MB of legacy project source, not committed); skipped by name in the CI tests/reset step, run locally under npm test
names: resumes from the next tile selected during legacy backtracking
defers overlay rebuild travel until closing the options surface
routes pause commands through an explicit legacy pause lifecycle contract
routes menu-time overlay field commits through an explicit legacy flag contract
